name: -10 AN Male to -10 AN Female Extender
title: -10 AN Male to -10 AN Female Extender
description:
The -10 AN Male to -10 AN Female Extender is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings -10AN Male to -10AN Female Extenders are precision CNC-machined to extend AN connections while maintaining a secure, leak-free 37-degree flare seal. Ideal for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, and power steering systems, these extenders provide additional clearance for tight engine bays, custom plumbing, and performance applications.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with an anodized finish for maximum corrosion resistance.
